policy: Only these six approved assets may be used as MedIndex logos.

markOnLight.usage: Icon or compact mark on white and light surfaces

fullOnLight.usage: Full wordmark on white and light surfaces

markOnDark.usage: Icon or compact mark on black and dark surfaces

fullOnDark.usage: Full wordmark on black and dark surfaces

horizontalOnLight.usage: Cropped transparent horizontal wordmark for expanded navigation and wide light surfaces

horizontalOnDark.usage: Cropped transparent horizontal wordmark for expanded navigation and wide dark surfaces
